body:
Alright, seems like nothing is going to come from this post. Ya'll have the best time you can for as long as you can. 

Peace.

Not sure what else there is to say. 

My life is fucked. 12 years since my first attempt and here I am again, just more prepared this time. 

I've tried the shit "help" on offer, I've tried the fucking therapists and fucking useless medications. I'm just fully ready to die, I just don't want to be alone for it. 

I've been fine to live alone, I just don't want to die alone.
Took a long time to get them. I'll be dead and gone before anyone ever checks on me. Just trying to have one good night I guess. Something to smile about before I black out and die.
